articles.title: Video generation models as world simulators
articles.description: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.
articles.raw_content: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.
articles.selection_reason: OpenAI's Sora technical report is the defining primary-source document on large-scale video diffusion transformers and directly anchors this segment's core focus on video synthesis.
articles.audience_value: Studio leads and media engineers get the architectural blueprint—spacetime latent patches, variable aspect ratios and durations—behind state-of-the-art text-to-video generation.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Sora's world-simulator framing sets the technical bar every video-generation pipeline in your studio will be measured against.

articles.title: Introducing next-generation audio models in the API
articles.description: For the first time, developers can also instruct the text-to-speech model to speak in a specific way—for example, “talk like a sympathetic customer service agent”—unlocking a new level of customization for voice agents.
articles.raw_content: For the first time, developers can also instruct the text-to-speech model to speak in a specific way—for example, “talk like a sympathetic customer service agent”—unlocking a new level of customization for voice agents.
articles.selection_reason: Steerable text-to-speech with instructable delivery style is a direct voice-synthesis breakthrough competing head-on with ElevenLabs-class tooling.
articles.audience_value: Creators gain API-level control over vocal performance—tone, persona, emotion—enabling scripted voice agents and narration without manual audio direction.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Directable TTS turns voice generation from a commodity into a performance tool, reshaping how you cast and produce synthetic voice work.

articles.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.0
articles.description: This 2026 launch introduced ChatGPT Images 2.0, with improved text rendering, multilingual support, and visual reasoning. See what’s new in Images 2.5.
articles.raw_content: This 2026 launch introduced ChatGPT Images 2.0, with improved text rendering, multilingual support, and visual reasoning. See what’s new in Images 2.5.
articles.selection_reason: A new flagship image model with improved text rendering, multilingual support and visual reasoning is a major state-of-the-art release for image generation workflows.
articles.audience_value: Designers and creative teams learn what Images 2.0 fixes—legible typography, non-English text, reasoning over compositions—and what to expect from the 2.5 follow-on.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Reliable in-image text and multilingual rendering remove the biggest production blockers for using AI imagery in real branded and localized campaigns.

articles.title: Introducing our latest image generation model in the API
articles.description: Our latest image generation model is now available in the API via ‘gpt-image-1’—enabling developers and businesses to build professional-grade, customizable visuals directly into their own tools and platforms.
articles.raw_content: Our latest image generation model is now available in the API via ‘gpt-image-1’—enabling developers and businesses to build professional-grade, customizable visuals directly into their own tools and platforms.
articles.selection_reason: gpt-image-1 in the API lets studios embed professional-grade image generation directly into their own creative tooling and pipelines.
articles.audience_value: AI media engineers get a production image endpoint to wire into asset pipelines, design tools, and automated content systems at scale.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: API access to a frontier image model is what converts creative experimentation into automated, repeatable studio workflows.

articles.title: Consistency Models
articles.description: Diffusion models have significantly advanced the fields of image, audio, and video generation, but they depend on an iterative sampling process that causes slow generation.
articles.raw_content: Diffusion models have significantly advanced the fields of image, audio, and video generation, but they depend on an iterative sampling process that causes slow generation.
articles.selection_reason: Consistency Models attack diffusion's core bottleneck—slow iterative sampling—with single-step generation across image, audio, and video.
articles.audience_value: Engineers understand the technique behind near-real-time diffusion inference, informing choices around latency, cost, and interactive creative tools.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: One-step generation is what makes live, interactive image and video creation economically feasible for your production stack.
